description: FULL BODY head to toe. A Malaysian female police officer in her late 30s. She is wearing a professional, dark navy blue Royal Malaysia Police uniform including a peaked cap, official badges, and polished black boots. Her expression is stern and authoritative. Malaysian ethnicity with medium skin tone.

FULL BODY head to toe. An elderly Malaysian woman in her late 60s. She is wearing a modest, loose-fitting Baju Kurung with a matching tudung (headscarf), and comfortable flat shoes. She has a friendly, approachable face. Malaysian ethnicity.

FULL BODY head to toe. A featureless, anonymous human figure rendered as a dark obsidian-black silhouette. The figure has glowing neon-cyan circuit-board patterns tracing through its limbs and a blank, smooth surface where a face would be, representing a digital threat.
